thread:
jaime-ops: FYI — BrightMap (acct B-572) opened a billing dispute. They claim an unexpected spike in embed units on May 2 that doesn't match their client-side telemetry.
chris-sales: CSM forwarded their raw logs. They see many 502s and then client SDK retries right around 2026-05-02T14:05:00Z. Asking for an ETA and number.
anya-platform: I sampled gateway traces. Looks like a small window where the HTTP client retried idempotently but generated new request_ids; our ledger keyed on request_id so retries counted as separate embeds. We do capture client_request_id about 72% of the time but ledger ingestion didn't dedupe on it.
joah-billing: Can we get a quick calc of duplicate embed units and an estimated refund? Need to know if this exceeds my $2k approval threshold.
anya-platform: Running quick aggregation now. Query: ```-- duplicate embeds by client_request_id in window
SELECT client_request_id, count(*) as cnt, sum(embedding_units) as units
FROM embed_ingest_raw
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-05-02T14:00:00Z' AND '2026-05-02T14:20:00Z'
GROUP BY client_request_id
HAVING count(*) > 1;```
Query sample: duplicate_rows=43, duplicated_units=91234, est_refund_usd=912.34 (using current unit price). This is preliminary; full ledger join may nudge the cents.
billing-bot: provisional-refund-created id=PR-20260502-B572 amount_usd=912.34 approver=noah-billing note="provisional pending full reconcile"
jaime-ops: Short term plan: issue provisional refund (<= $2k) and schedule dedupe backfill BF-20260502-dedupe to replay raw events consolidating on client_request_id. Backfill will be audit-first: will not change historic invoice lines, only produce reconciliation report and ledger adjustments if verified. Estimated run 3h incl. verification.
chris-sales: I'll notify the CSM/Cust: "We've issued a provisional credit of $912.34. We're running an internal dedupe reconciliation and will confirm within 72 hours."
joah-billing: Approving provisional refund $912.34. Please attach CSV of client_request_id collisions and run id for audit.
anya-platform: Will attach export and schedule BF-20260502-dedupe. Also opening a router change to emit dedupe_key = client_request_id into metering events to prevent future duplicates. PR: https://git.internal/r/route/emit-dedupe-key
jaime-ops: Backfill job BF-20260502-dedupe created, runbook RB-dedupe-embeds-002. Canaried on 1% traffic, no duplication detected in canary. Full run scheduled at 2026-05-03T02:00:00Z.
chris-sales: Notified customer and CC'd finance. Will update thread when they ack.
noah-billing: Once backfill finishes, please post final ledger delta and I'll post the final credit memo if needed. For now provisional refund approved and queued. Thanks.
